LRU Cache with Time-To-Live (TTL) Expiry

This module implements a thread-safe Least Recently Used (LRU) cache where each
entry carries an absolute expiry timestamp. Once the TTL expires, the entry is
automatically removed from the cache. A dedicated background thread periodically
cleans up expired entries to prevent the cache from growing unbounded.

The module exposes:

* ``LRUCache`` – the core cache implementation.
* ``LRUCacheWrapper`` – a higher-level wrapper that exposes a clean API for
  storing and retrieving values.
* ``pytest`` suite – a comprehensive test suite that validates correctness,
  thread-safety and TTL behaviour.

Design highlights
-----------------
* Uses ``collections.OrderedDict`` for O(1) LRU semantics.
* Each value is wrapped in a small ``CacheEntry`` dataclass so that the expiry
  timestamp is stored alongside the payload.
* A background ``_CleanupThread`` runs every ``TTL_CLEANUP_INTERVAL`` seconds.
  The interval defaults to 1 second but can be tuned.
* Thread safety is achieved via a single ``threading.Lock``.
* The cache does not copy payloads; it stores references. If the underlying
  objects are mutated after insertion, the cache still observes the mutated
  reference (this is acceptable for immutable or reference-typed payloads).

Dependencies
------------
* ``pytest`` >= 7.0
* Standard library only (no third-party imports beyond ``pytest``).

=======================================

This module provides a robust, thread-safe LRU cache that automatically
expires entries after a configurable time-to-live (TTL). It combines the
concepts of a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache and a TTL-based eviction
policy to provide both performance (via LRU) and freshness guarantees.

Key Features
------------
* LRU Eviction: Entries are evicted when the cache reaches capacity, with
  the least recently accessed item removed first.
* TTL Expiry: Each entry carries an expiration timestamp. Entries older than
  the configured TTL are automatically removed on read or on capacity eviction.
* Thread Safety: All cache operations are protected by a reentrant lock
  (`threading.RLock`) so that concurrent reads and writes do not corrupt the
  internal data structures.
* Memory Efficiency: Uses a combination of a doubly-linked list (for order)
  and a hash map (for O(1) lookups) to achieve O(1) get/set/evict operations.
* Pytest Suite: Includes a comprehensive test suite covering basic LRU
  behavior, TTL expiry, thread safety, edge cases, and concurrent access.

1. _CacheNode: A simple doubly-linked list node storing the key, value,
